name: a bare address holding a bracket
why: A renderer autolinks the whole run up to the space and escapes the ']' into the href, landing on github.com/attacker/evil, while a reader that stops at the ']' is left holding an allowed prefix of it. A fact writes a link as [text](url) and nothing else, so a bare address is refused rather than read.
fails: writes a link in a form this snapshot does not read
